Mr. Ali is also actively engaged in social and cultural activities and holds senior positions in several hospitals, demonstrating his commitment to giving back to the community. Mr. Ali holds a Master’s degree in economics and graduate diplomas in development economics from Oxford University, as well as a diploma in management sciences from the University of Manchester.
